unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Keep included as NEEDS_REVIEW and replace the generic name only after primary-source identity confirmation.

notes: InfraRed Capital Partners' official investment, case-study, acquisition, and portfolio materials were reviewed together with relevant HICL-managed asset pages.
